full_judgment: 15. This question as to the inadmissibility  of a document need to have been taken under the law at the earliest possible opportunity and that having not been taken initially it would be late now to agitate those on revision. Further, that certificate issued by the Chairman is a certificate issued in his official capacity and thus an official document as to which there would be a presumption of correctness and regularity under the Evidence Act. the learned lawyer could not refer to any provision of law under which that certificate would be inadmissible when the genuineness of the same or the signature of the Chairman in the said or his legal authority to certify so was not challenged and not argued before this Court. The same applies to the Biman papers and also to the death certificate dated 17.11.79 issued as to the death of Nasu Khan by another doctor namely Dr. M. A. Rahman of Cardio Clinic, Nirala, Khulna certifying that Nasu Khan died of "Cerebro-Vascular" accident due to hyper-tension on 11.11.79 at 4.35 A. M. at 7/3 South Central Road, Khulna at his residence". These papers are shown before this Court by a supplementary affidavit by the, opposite party with a copy to the petition; which remained unchallenged.
